Pandi, Bulacan Dear Mayor Oca: This has reference to your earlier letter asking this Department's legal opinion on whether or not Section 444 (b)(l) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160) pertaining to the authorization from the Sangguniang Bayan before a Municipal Mayor can represent the municipality in all its business transactions and before signing all bonds, contracts and obligations and such other documents made pursuant to law or ordinance, admits of certain exemptions under existing laws and jurisprudence. In reply thereto, please be informed that this Department had already answered a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 30, series of 2007. In the said legal opinion, we opined that said rule accepts of certain exceptions. If a law or ordinance already authorizes the Municipal Mayor to enter into a particular contract, such authority given by law can already be a sufficient legal basis for the Municipal Mayor to enter into a contract for and in behalf of the municipality even if there is no prior authorization from the Sanggunian. Hereto attached is a photocopy of the aforesaid DILG Opinion for your ready perusal. Thank you and warm regards. Ls/17 Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. JESUS Dire DOQU IV 111
